techStack: TypeScript 6.0.2, Vitest 4.1.5, Express 5.2.1, tsx 4.22.4, vite 8.0.10 (installed but not used for build)
Build tooling: tsc via `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`; dev via tsx
allowImportingTsExtensions: true requires moduleResolution to be 'bundler' (not 'node') — TS5095
verbatimModuleSyntax: true, moduleDetection: force, erasableSyntaxOnly: true, noEmit: true in base tsconfig
tsconfig.build.json overrides: allowImportingTsExtensions→false, noEmit→false, adds outDir/rootDir
features: Only test file: src/tests/visible/products.test.ts (uses .test.ts suffix, not .spec.ts)
Only setup file: tests/setup.ts (at project root level 'tests/', NOT inside 'src/tests/')
vitest.config.ts current state: globals: false, include: ['src/**/*.spec.ts'], setupFiles: ['./src/tests/setup.ts']
tsconfig.json current state: moduleResolution: 'node', allowImportingTsExtensions: true, noEmit: true
tsconfig.build.json: extends tsconfig.json, overrides allowImportingTsExtensions→false, noEmit→false, adds outDir: 'dist', rootDir: 'src'
server.ts: const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT); — NaN when PORT unset; logs 'Server running on port {PORT}'
architecture: Directory layout: src/ (app.ts, server.ts, controllers/, data/, middleware/, routes/, services/, tests/visible/, types/, utils/), tests/ (setup.ts), tsconfig.json, tsconfig.build.json, vitest.config.ts
tsconfig.build.json extends tsconfig.json — changes to base propagate to build config
tsconfig.build.json does NOT set moduleResolution — changing base tsconfig.json moduleResolution to 'bundler' affects both configs
tsconfig.build.json already overrides allowImportingTsExtensions: false, so build emit is unaffected by base config change
All config fixes are in top-level config files; no changes to src/ application logic except server.ts port fallback
vitest.config.ts lives at benchmark-backend root — paths in setupFiles are relative to this file
edgeCases: Glob must be exactly src/**/*.test.ts — not src/**/*.{test,spec}.ts — per requirement 1
setupFiles path must be ./tests/setup.ts (not ./src/tests/setup.ts) — the actual file is at benchmark-backend/tests/setup.ts
Number(undefined) → NaN; Number('') → 0; fallback || 3001 covers both unset and empty-string PORT cases
Changing moduleResolution to 'bundler' in tsconfig.json does not conflict with tsconfig.build.json because build config does not set moduleResolution itself
tsconfig.build.json sets allowImportingTsExtensions: false — valid with any moduleResolution value, so no conflict after base change
No other files import from vitest.config.ts — changing it has no ripple effect

tasks.requirement: 1 — vitest.config.ts include glob must be src/**/*.test.ts
tasks.description: In vitest.config.ts, change the include array value from 'src/**/*.spec.ts' to 'src/**/*.test.ts' so Vitest discovers the existing products.test.ts file
In vitest.config.ts, change globals from false to true so that describe, it, expect, beforeAll, beforeEach, afterEach, vi etc. are available without per-file imports

tasks.requirement: 3 — vitest.config.ts setupFiles path must resolve to the file that exists
tasks.description: In vitest.config.ts, change the setupFiles entry from './src/tests/setup.ts' to './tests/setup.ts' to point at the actual setup file at benchmark-backend/tests/setup.ts

tasks.requirement: 4 — tsconfig.json must not contain an invalid option combination causing TS5095
tasks.description: In tsconfig.json, change moduleResolution from 'node' to 'bundler' to make it compatible with allowImportingTsExtensions: true. tsconfig.build.json extends tsconfig.json and already overrides allowImportingTsExtensions: false, so the build is unaffected.

tasks.requirement: 5 — src/server.ts must provide a numeric fallback of 3001 when process.env.PORT is absent
tasks.description: In server.ts, change 'const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT)' to 'const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3001' so the server binds to 3001 instead of NaN when PORT is unset
